lines.text: Many learners say: My phone is different with yours.
Better: My phone is different from yours.
Say different from. Do not say different with.
From! My phone is different from yours.

data.wrong: My phone is different with yours.
data.right: My phone is different from yours.
data.why: Say different from. Do not say different with.
